title: fix(ui): Console CSV downloads built in the browser start with a UTF-8 byte-order mark
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRT27U1unc64yMdYqqPWFjw)_
Fixes #34420
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 在浏览器里自己拼出来的 CSV 下载（列表导出兜底、表格导出兜底、data-table 导出、报表 CSV、批量操作错误 CSV、身份导入临时密码 CSV，共六处）现在文件开头都带 UTF-8 BOM，统一走 `@object-ui/core` 新增的 `csvBlob(text)`。
- 为什么改：Excel 打开没有 BOM 的 CSV 按系统代码页解码，中文客户导出的姓名、数值全是乱码；服务端导出早已修好，这六个最常用的按钮还没有。
- 风险与回滚：只在文件头多 3 个字节（EF BB BF），CSV 导入本来就会剥掉开头一个 BOM，导出再导入不受影响；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/utils/csv-blob.ts`（唯一的新逻辑）；`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExportEngine.ts`（把下载拆成 `downloadBlob`，其余格式行为不变）；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`（认领清单外的第六处，同类同修）。
- 两分钟验证：在中文界面的列表里点「导出 → CSV」（无服务端导出的数据源），用 Excel 打开，中文正常显示；或跑 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/csvByteOrderMark-34420.test.tsx`，预期 2 个测试通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `csvBlob(text)` and `UTF8_BYTE_ORDER_MARK` in `@object-ui/core` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/csv-blob.ts`, exported from the package barrel). `csvBlob` returns a `Blob` holding exactly one U+FEFF (bytes EF BB BF) followed by the text, typed `text/csv;charset=utf-8`. `@object-ui/core` is the lowest package every writer already depends on, so no package edge is added.
- Six writers now build their file through it:
  - `ListView` client-side export fallback (`plugin-list`);
  - `ObjectGrid` client-side export fallback, csv branch (`plugin-grid`);
  - `BulkActionDialog` "Download error CSV" (`plugin-grid`) — a sixth writer the card did not list, see Acceptance notes;
  - `data-table` Export CSV (`components`); its file is now typed with `charset=utf-8` too;
  - `exportAsCSV` in `ReportExportEngine` (`plugin-report`); the engine's private download helper is split so a built `Blob` can be handed over (`downloadBlob`), and `downloadFile` delegates to it with unchanged behaviour for the JSON, HTML and TSV paths;
  - `IdentityImportResultExtra` temporary-password CSV (`app-shell`).
- Three existing pins that read an export through `Blob.text()` and compare exact strings now read the text after the mark (`data-table-masked-column-10583`, `maskedColumnSurfaces-10583`, and `ObjectDataTable.maskedColumn-10657` in `plugin-dashboard`, whose table exports through the `data-table` path); their masking assertions are unchanged. The `ObjectDataTable` pin also asserts the mark is there, so it pins the mark too.
- Changeset `.changeset/34420-console-csv-bom.md`: patch for the six touched `@object-ui/*` packages.

## Tests

One byte-level pin per writer, each reading the downloaded Blob through `arrayBuffer()` (not `text()`, which may hide the mark), asserting the first three bytes are EF BB BF, that no second mark follows, and that the header row and a Chinese value follow intact. Plus a unit test for the helper.

- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/csv-blob.test.ts`
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.csvByteOrderMark-34420.test.tsx`
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/csvByteOrderMark-34420.test.tsx` (ObjectGrid and BulkActionDialog)
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-csvByteOrderMark-34420.test.tsx`
- `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportExportEngine.csvByteOrderMark-34420.test.tsx`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/IdentityImportPanels.csvByteOrderMark-34420.test.tsx`

Red on main, green on the fix, red again under an ablation of the helper (readings in Verification). The `ObjectDataTable.maskedColumn-10657` repair (fix round 1) was red in CI on `4ccfd11ba0` (Test UI shard 12/16, two cases, `expected '(U+FEFF)Name' to be 'Name'`), is green on `16fd89c1bd`, and is red again under the same helper ablation on the mark assertion.

## Acceptance notes

- **A sixth writer, fixed in place.** `BulkActionDialog`'s error CSV (`downloadErrors`) built `text/csv` without the mark, the same defect as the five the card named. It is fixed here under the bounded in-place exemption: same defect class, the mechanical one-call change the other five take, no open PR touches the file (merge-tree check below), and it sits in `plugin-grid`, already in this PR's test family. The claim's declared file surface does not list it; that is stated here and in the report rather than left for a reviewer to find.
- **Test files outside the claim surface.** Three existing test files changed because they compare exported CSV text exactly and now see the mark: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-masked-column-10583.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/maskedColumnSurfaces-10583.test.tsx`, and (fix round 1) `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectDataTable.maskedColumn-10657.test.tsx`. Before the fix-round push, the whole `ui/` tree was searched for tests that capture a download through `createObjectURL` and read its contents, and for tests that click any of the six writers: no other test compares the text of a file one of the six writers builds (the `DatasetWidget` and `DatasetReportRenderer` readers already strip a mark their writers always wrote).
- **Writers already correct are left as they are.** `DatasetWidget`'s `downloadCsv` (`plugin-dashboard`), `ImportWizard`'s failed-rows CSV (`plugin-grid`), `ReportExport`'s dataset CSV and the TSV exports in `ReportExportEngine` and `LiveReportExporter` (`plugin-report`) already prepend the mark themselves. Moving them onto `csvBlob` is outside the claim's file surface and changes no bytes, so it is not done here.
- **Round trip.** The CSV import strips one leading mark: `parseCsvToRows` in `packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts` and `readCsvRequestRecords` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/identityImport.ts` both begin by removing one leading U+FEFF. A file downloaded from any of the six writers therefore imports as before. Neither is changed.
- **Server export.** `RelatedList` and the server-stream branches of `ListView` and `ObjectGrid` save the server's own body, which already carries the mark; they are untouched.
- **Test placement.** Each package gets one issue-named file, following the per-issue naming these packages already use; none of the six writers has a single shared export harness file.
- **Byte spelling.** The first commit of `csv-blob.ts` held a raw U+FEFF character where the source should spell the escape (the authoring tool materialised it). The next commit restores the escape spelling; the tree holds no raw mark in any file this PR touches. `check:nul-bytes` does not look for U+FEFF (it is not a control byte), so only a manual byte scan caught it.

## Verification

Readings name the head they were taken on; the final head is `16fd89c1bd` (fix round 1 added one test-file commit on top of `4ccfd11ba0`); tests run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
